extraction.Name: Chris Colome (also spelled Chris Colombo)
extraction.NOTES: Document concerns Chris Colome's purchase of land from William McCloskey or Dillon (allotment 2331) for approximately $3500; payments made circa 1909-1910 by signing a note with Dillon for lumber from Montgomery Lumber Company of Winner, which Colome ultimately paid; from then until about 1919 Colome arranged store credit at Colome and provided horses, harness, buggy, piano money and other things; when land was purchased Dillon owed Colome over $800 after deducting the agreed price; Dillon acknowledged the debt but died without paying it. Notary: Jas. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32. Subscribed and sworn 18th day of June 1929.
